Travel

A month of travel giveaways

Every week, we’re giving 7 people $5,000 toward their dream vacation—plus, one lucky grand prize winner will get $15,000 to put toward the trip of a lifetime! See below for details. 

How to enter

Get weekly inspiration  

Each week in June, our celebrity friends will share a few favorite destinations, centered around a travel theme. Follow along on Instagram—every week will be different!

Week 1 (Jun 1–7): Outdoor getaways with Henry Golding

Week 2 (Jun 8–14): Beachy vacations with Nina Dobrev 

Week 3 (Jun 15–21): Relaxing retreats with Ashley Graham

Week 4 (Jun 22–28): City destinations with Indya Moore 

Submit an on-theme photo 

Send us an original vacation photo that matches the weekly theme. It can be a snap you took on a trip, or a picture of a travel memento you’ve held on to. You can enter up to once a week. 

Start (mentally) packing your bags

7 people each week will win $5,000—you could be one of them. At the end of the month, we’ll pick one winner from all the entries who’ll take home $15,000! Enter every week to boost your odds.

Submit your photo for a chance to win 

This week’s travel deal

We’ll put $30 in your Affirm Savings account when you book with Expedia and pay over time with us. (No account? No problem—it’s simple to open one.) Offer ends June 7. See details.
